native_review: All eight frames were opened at native resolution. The art contains no rendered letters, logos, watermarks, nooses, blood, or gore. Page 8 panel 3 is one generated frame with two bottom insets as required. The Portuguese hold and 1738 sailing ship details are period appropriate. Keshavrao remains distinct from Nagoji by his short hair, faint moustache, grey-brown rags, and no ear stud. The Nagoji candidates keep the brand area covered or turned away, with the tiny flush gold stud and no dangling ornament. Blank outlined reserves were measured in top-left source-pixel coordinates.
